regions.summary: Code with 1 routine unit(s) (FlushVramQueue); descriptive branch labels, symbolic operands and inline comments.

units.name: FlushVramQueue
units.summary: Called from NMI with bank 0 mapped. Copies each VramQueue record to the PPU: the mode byte picks PPUCTRL increment bits from VramModeCtrlBits, then address hi/lo and data bytes follow until $FF. A $FF followed by a byte >= 3 is a literal $FF data byte (the @loop2 path writes $FF and continues). Mode 0 ends the queue, which is then emptied (VramQueue = 0, VramQueueLen = 0).

units.name: BuildOamFromObjects
units.summary: Called from NMI with bank 0 mapped. units.name: Hit_Type1C

units.name: Hit_Type1D
units.summary: Final boss (Dracula) hit handling ($7A phase flag, sound slot $B2 test).

units.name: Hit_Clank
units.summary: Plays the "clank" sound ($10) for an invulnerable hit.

units.name: Hit_Type04

units.name: Hit_Type1F
units.summary: Turns the object into type $34 for $54 frames, stunned.

units.name: UpdatePairBossHealth
units.summary: BossHealth = this part's health + the partner's (slot $17) if it is a type $1A part.

units.name: SubtractBossDamage
units.summary: BossHealth:BossHealthLo -= damage $0D:$0C, clamped at 0.

units.name: Hit_Ignore
units.summary: Hit result for invulnerable/ignored types: nothing happens.
